The every-Go-file fallback counts .go and module files, as decided. A command moved by a cd into another module also reads that module's non-Go files (testdata, embedded files, fixtures read through ..), which the fallback does not count. A change to only such a file would not select the job. This is the decided rule's boundary, not a departure from it.
